children: Exelixis reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $658.7 million, up 10.2% from the prior-year quarter, while net income rose 12.7% to $218.1 million and diluted EPS increased 23.2% to $0.85. Product revenue growth was led by CABOMETYX.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.

Net product revenue increased 11% to $604.9 million, led by CABOMETYX. U.S. sales growth reflected 6% higher unit volume and improved net selling prices, with demand in renal cell carcinoma and neuroendocrine tumors.
The FDA extended its review of the colorectal cancer application for zanzalintinib, setting a new target action date of March 3, 2027.
Enrollment began in the STELLAR-316 trial for patients with minimal residual disease-positive colorectal cancer. STELLAR-202 and new STELLAR-002 cohorts also launched.
Management expects product revenue to grow through the rest of 2026 and is increasing launch preparations for zanzalintinib.
